title: Read one page of path history
responsibility: Fetch a bounded history page for distinct paths and merge duplicate commits.

inputs.name: githubHistoryPage.context
inputs.description: Source adapter for resolving the commit and transport for GitHub history requests.

inputs.name: githubHistoryPage.repository
inputs.description: Repository whose history is being read.

inputs.name: githubHistoryPage.input
inputs.description: Exact commit SHA, at most 64 safe paths, page starting at 1 and page size 1–100; defaults are 1 and 30.

outputs.name: githubHistoryPage
outputs.description: Distinct commits in response insertion order, completion flag and next page number or null; an empty path list returns an empty complete page.
